title: Empty ShopCoach title and description show the question prompts
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A04 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A04 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
  • {Asset-A} has a year, make and model filled in (for example 2018 Freightliner Cascadia), so ShopCoach can suggest lines for it.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1} and go to its Lines tab.
  2. Click New Line.
  3. Click AI SHOPCOACH LINE BUILDER.
  4. Describe the job (for example brakes grinding) and click Build Lines.
  5. Wait until suggested lines appear.
  6. Click the title cell of the first suggested line.
  7. Delete all the text in the editor.
  8. Read the grey text inside the editor.
  9. Click the description cell of the same line.
  10. Delete all the text in the editor.
  11. Read the grey text inside the editor.
  12. Click outside the table.
  13. Read the two emptied cells in the table.
  14. Close the builder without adding any line.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 8: the empty Title editor shows "What are you doing?".
  • Step 11: the empty Description editor shows "Why are you doing it?".
  • Step 13: the emptied cells read "What are you doing?" and "Why are you doing it?", with only the first letter a capital (not "What Are You Doing?").

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10131 (Story 2, The ShopCoach Line Builder); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S2-R2, read 13 Oct 2026; no design board exists for this story (tech plan: Story 2 and Story 4 are text-only), labels from the Jira story and tech plan; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-006; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R2: “Both carry the same placeholders as S1-R3.”
  • S1-R3: “The Title box carries the placeholder "What are you doing?" and the Description box carries "Why are you doing it?". Placeholder text shows while the box is empty and disappears as soon as there is a value.”
  • SV-10131 acceptance criteria: “Given the ShopCoach line builder is open with both fields empty, then the placeholders read "What are you doing?" and "Why are you doing it?".”
  • Tech plan FR-006: “The builder's two editors are labelled "Title" / "Description" with the FR-003 placeholders; the empty-cell fallback text reads "What are you doing?" / "Why are you doing it?" in sentence case (S2-R1, S2-R2).”
